architect_identity.name_ja: 佐藤慎也＋メジロスタジオ

identity_evidence: 3331 identifies the facility as an independent art center created by renovating the former Chiyoda City Rensei Junior High School and operating from 2010 until 2023.
The official 3331 Architectural Document states that Shinya Sato and Mejiro Studio were responsible for the renovation design.
Galleries, studios, creative offices, workshops, community areas, a cafe and a shop form the program of one art center; they do not make the project a museum or generic mixed-use complex.
